title: Lovely space in the heart of Belmont/12 South
description:
Carriage house near Vanderbilt and Belmont, walking distance to 12 South located in the historic Belmont Hillsboro neighborhood.  The space contains one queen bed and a sleeper sofa with a double bed.  Four and a half blocks to 12 South,  one quarter of a mile to Belmont University.  We kindly and firmly request that all guests be non-smokers (if you are a smoker, this unit is not for you). Smoking is not allowed on the property or on surrounding neighbors' properties.

Other things to note
You can either enter off the alley in the back (message for code, or enter through the backyard.
